art_direction: 一枚珊瑚色有机拱形与乳白圆片相叠，深青背景，少量形状完成构图。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Make a flat graphic composition from one thick coral-colored organic arch and a small warm-ivory disc. The arch should lean slightly, with unequal rounded ends and a generous open center. Place the disc partly inside that opening rather than directly on top. Use a deep muted teal background to establish contrast, with no gradients, outlines, or simulated depth. Let subtle asymmetry in the curve provide the character. Keep every edge crisp and the composition limited to these two interlocking forms. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
